$comment: Single source of truth for WASM memory sizing across every module Hyphon links.
Consumed by emscripten/build.sh (-s INITIAL_MEMORY / -s MAXIMUM_MEMORY),
emscripten/build_rubberband.sh, emscripten/build_mix_bus.sh, and by
src/audio-worklets/hyphonNativeImports.ts, which allocates the imported
WebAssembly.Memory for the AudioWorklet instantiation path. The two MUST agree:
an imported memory whose `initial` is below the module's declared minimum fails
instantiation, and one far above it wastes address space (and can fail outright
on mobile Safari / low-end Chromebooks when `shared: true`).
See docs/wasm/BUILD_NOTES.md#four-worlds-memory-budget for the derivation.
Voices only: Open303 / JC303 / Prophecy / HighFid303 / analog drumkit. Rubber
Band (its ~40 MB stretch transient) and audio_dsp.cpp (#1341) live in their own
modules, and main() + the Pyodide bootstrap are gone.
Measured (2026-10-13, emcc 6.0.9 -O3 -flto pthread build, node,
`node tools/render_hyphon_native_parity.mjs heap`): 3x Open303 at 4x oversample,
3x JC303, 3x high-fid at 2x, 2x Prophecy and the drum kit, 192 kHz / 4096-frame
blocks, peak at 8.47 MB = 8.02 MB stack + static, 0.45 MB voice heap (identical
on the 3.1.51 -O1 build). 32 MB leaves ~23 MB of heap, ~50x the measured voice
set, before the first (shared) grow; it was 128 MB.
2026-10-19, macro-* (Plaits) voices added: each part owns 8 voices of ~11 KB
state + 16 KB engine RAM (plaits.cc's shared_buffer) and a 33 KB resampler
table. Same heap tool with SYNTH A + SYNTH B on macro, 16 voices sounding:
static + stack 8.99 → 9.21 MB, voice heap 1.79 → 2.18 MB, peak 10.78 → 11.39 MB
of the 32 MB initial memory. No change to these numbers needed.
Single-threaded voice module public/hyphon_native.st.{js,wasm} (no -pthread,
IMPORTED_MEMORY=1, non-shared). Same voices and exports as hyphonNative.
Loaded when the page is not crossOriginIsolated, on WebKit, or when
Open303Config.forceSingleThreaded is set. Consumed by emscripten/build.sh and by
src/audio-worklets/hyphonNativeImports.ts (HYPHON_NATIVE_ST_* pages).
Measured (2026-09-14, release ST build, node): the full voice set — 3x Open303 at
4x oversample, 3x JC303, 3x live high-fid at 2x, 2x Prophecy, 192 kHz / 4096-frame
blocks — peaks at ~2 MB above the 1 MB stack + data (2026-10-13 re-measure with
the drum kit added: 0.45 MB voice heap, 1.47 MB high-water). 16 MB is 8x that; the memory
is non-shared, so growth past it is a cheap ArrayBuffer grow, not a new SAB.
See docs/wasm/BUILD_NOTES.md#threading-profiles.

static + stack 1.99 → 2.21 MB, voice heap 1.81 → 2.11 MB, peak 3.80 → 4.32 MB —
still under 30 % of the 16 MB initial memory.

Standalone public/rubberband.wasm, built by emscripten/build_rubberband.sh and
instantiated by src/audio-worklets/{rubberband,sustain}-processor.ts through
createRubberBandModule(). This module owns its memory (it is NOT imported), so
the only contract is that build_rubberband.sh reads these numbers instead of
carrying literals. Growth stays on (BUILD_NOTES#rubberband-memory-growth):
loadBuffer copies the whole, uncapped sample into the heap. Measured
2026-10-27 (emcc 6.0.9 -O3 -flto): the real-time stretcher, R3 finer stereo
included, never grows an 8 MB heap, so 64 MB is ~4 min of 48 kHz sample
before the first grow; 256 MB bounds it. rubberbandHeapGrowth.integration
proves the worklets re-derive every heap view after a grow.
Standalone public/mix_bus.wasm, built by emscripten/build_mix_bus.sh and
instantiated only inside src/workers/mixBus.worker.ts (offline stem mix, #1341).
The module owns a fixed, non-shared memory that never grows: two static
64k-frame scratch blocks (512 KiB) plus the stack. Stems stream through
the scratch a block at a time, so song length never changes this number.
There is deliberately no maximumMemoryMb — the build passes
ALLOW_MEMORY_GROWTH=0 and tools/check_mix_bus_module.mjs rejects a module
whose maximum differs from its initial size.
